audit.notes: Can be completely recreated using any clips of dedicated focus—such as working on a laptop, morning routine, or training at the climbing gym. Simply cut clips on the rhythmic audio beats and overlay the inspirational affirmations.
audit.summary: A fast-paced montage of aesthetic study and productive work clips timed to a motivational audio track with synced affirmation text overlays.
